name: The Weaver
summary: In Silverpine Forest, Ataeric works to awaken a dormant ley energy node for Dalaran. Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher sends you to stop the archmage and take his staff, keeping Dalaran’s magic from threatening Forsaken control of the southern reaches of Lordaeron.

sections.title: Severing the Ley Thread
sections.body: After earlier inquiries into Ambermill and Dalaran’s movements, the Forsaken learned that the wizards are trying to awaken a dormant ley energy node in Silverpine Forest. If Dalaran gains its concentrated arcane power, it could strengthen its position and threaten the Undercity’s hold over southern Lordaeron.

sections.title: The Archmage's Fall
sections.body: Shadow Priest Allister knows the operation must be stopped at its source. Archmage Ataeric directs the work, protected by wards and fellow magi. Slaying him and claiming his staff scatters the gathered magic, returns the ley energies to dormancy, and thwarts the Kirin Tor’s plans in the valley.

faq.answer: The Weaver is Archmage Ataeric, a powerful Dalaran spellcaster in Silverpine Forest. He is trying to weave together and awaken the latent ley energies beneath the area.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken want the archmage killed?
faq.answer: The Forsaken fear that Dalaran will draw vast arcane power from the dormant ley energy node, close to the Undercity. Shadow Priest Allister sees that as a threat to Forsaken sovereignty and orders Ataeric killed before the node is fully active.

faq.q: What happens after Ataeric is defeated?
faq.answer: With Ataeric slain and his staff taken, the arcane network collapses. The gathered spells dissipate and the ley line returns to dormancy, depriving the Kirin Tor of its main foothold of arcane power in southern Silverpine.

faq.q: Who sends you on this quest?
faq.answer: Shadow Priest Allister, a Forsaken authority at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest, gives you the order after examining earlier intelligence about Dalaran’s presence around Ambermill.

faq.q: What is the significance of Ataeric's staff?
faq.answer: Archmage Ataeric’s staff focuses and channels the regional ley energies. Taking it ensures the magic unravels completely and gives Allister an artifact he might study for the Forsaken’s own designs.

faq.q: Where does Dalaran's presence in Silverpine come from?
aliases: why are dalaran mages in silverpine
faq.answer: Though Dalaran was devastated during the Third War, remnants of the Kirin Tor keep fortified enclaves, outposts, and arcane experiments in nearby territories such as Ambermill. They seek to regain control and harness vital magical reserves.

angles.text: As an Undead, you face Dalaran’s living magi, who dispute Forsaken control over the ruins of Lordaeron. Stopping their archmage helps secure the Sepulcher’s perimeter.
As a Mage, you know ley lines demand deep mastery of arcane geometry. Ataeric’s fall shows how delicate such rituals become when their main conduits are lost.
As a Priest, you see Shadow Priest Allister direct this operation through cold resolve, aiming to extinguish an arcane catalyst before it grows in power.
As a member of the Horde, you face Dalaran’s hostile remnants. Any growth in their arcane strength threatens Horde lands in northern Lordaeron.
